{"metadata":{"description":"a plugin for dsh to check cost and change backgroud","id":"gh:1338425616","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-WallpaperAndCost","slug":"AppliedYuu/dsh-WallpaperAndCost","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"a plugin for dsh to check cost and change backgroud"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-WallpaperAndCost"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A merged DSH web plugin combining **wallpaper customization** and the **DeepSeek balance & usage wid"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"ed DSH web plugin combining **wallpaper customization** and the **DeepSeek balance & usage widget**."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"### 🎨 Wallpaper (壁纸)
- 8 built-in curated gradients (暮色 / 深渊 / 晨曦 / 森林 / 星夜 / 暖阳 / 青空 / 石墨)
- Upload"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" your own images **at full original resolution** (no compression), stored in IndexedDB
- **动态壁纸：上传 M"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"P4/WebM 视频，自动静音循环播放**（铺底 `<video>` 元素，object-fit: cover）
- Crop editor: drag to pan + zoom (100%–250"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"%) with a live viewport-proportional preview
- Independent **absolute opacity sliders (0–100%)** for"},{"id":"p5s5","text":" the left sidebar, the conversation column and the right sidebar — the right-sidebar slider now driv"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"es **both** the dsh-better-sidebar panel *and* DSH's official right sidebar (dsh-client-ui-sidebar-r"},{"id":"p5s7","text":"ight, detected via `[data-sidebar-right-panel]`); the slider auto-appears whenever either sidebar is"},{"id":"p5s8","text":" present
- Wallpaper choice persists across restarts (localStorage + IndexedDB)
- **创意工坊壁纸提取（服务器目录）*"},{"id":"p5s9","text":"*：输入 Wallpaper Engine 创意工坊条目文件夹的绝对路径（`…steamapps\workshop\content\431960\<id>`），由内置的 `scripts/extrac"},{"id":"p5s10","text":"t_scene_pkg.py` 解析 `scene.pkg` / `.tex`（含 LZ4 解压、DXT/RGBA→PNG、内嵌 MP4），提取最佳壁纸供预览与下载。需要运行 DSH 的机器装有 Py"},{"id":"p5s11","text":"thon 3（脚本为纯 Python，Pillow 可选）。
- **桌面端支持「选择文件夹…」**：DSH Desktop（Windows）上可直接用系统原生文件夹选择器选取条目文件夹，自动填入绝对"},{"id":"p5s12","text":"路径，避免手输/粘贴路径出错而报"文件夹不存在"。
- **路径自动规整 + 明确报错**：路径会先去空白、剥成对引号、展开 `~`，并校验是否为绝对路径；读取失败会区分「文件夹不存在」「没有权限读取"},{"id":"p5s13","text":"该文件夹（含 Windows 受控文件夹访问拦截）」「路径不是文件夹」，不再把权限问题笼统报成"文件夹不存在"。"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"### 🔍 Wallpaper Engine 创意工坊提取脚本
- 仓库自带独立脚本 `scripts/extract_scene_pkg.py`，可单独命令行使用："},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- 支持容器：PKGV（scene.pkg）、TEXV0005/TEXI0001/TEXB000x（.tex）。内容类型：内嵌 JPEG/MP4、DXT1/3/5→.dds（有 Pillow 转 .p"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ng）、RGBA8888/R8 裸像素→.png、其余文件原样导出。
- 浏览器端另有无需 Python 的「从 Wallpaper 导入」入口（File System Access API 纯 JS"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"88/R8 裸像素→.png、其余文件原样导出。
- 浏览器端另有无需 Python 的「从 Wallpaper 导入」入口（File System Access API 纯 JS 解包），两者互补。"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### 💰 Balance & usage (余额与用量)
- Balance button in the conversation header: balance, today's consumpt"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ion, this session's token usage & estimated cost
- Prices come from **`pricing.json`** (data, not co"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"de): regex model ids, an optional peak/off-peak split, CNY per million tokens — see Model pricing
- "},{"id":"p9s4","text":"Per-model and per-window (peak/off-peak) breakdown in the popover
- The per-session ledger is **dura"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"ble**: a host restart no longer zeroes the token meter. It is written to `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-wal"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"lpaper-cost-sessions.json` and dropped only once that conversation is archived/deleted
- Platform co"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"nsumption (`DEEPSEEK_PLATFORM_TOKEN`) is read from DSH's credential store by the host (`ctx.credenti"},{"id":"p9s8","text":"als.resolve`), the same way `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` and `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY` are — no in-widget token ca"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"pture
- The DeepSeek API key never leaves the host (host-side routes only)"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### 🏷 Model pricing (`pricing.json`)"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The price table is one JSON file at the package root — editing it needs no code change and no rebuil"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"d; the host reloads it as soon as its mtime changes, and history is re-priced on the next replay."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- **Regex ids**: a vendor prefix (`deepseek-official/deepseek-v4-flash`) is stripped before matching"},{"id":"p13s2","text":", so `deepseek.*flash` covers `deepseek-flash`, `deepseek-v4-flash` and `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-ex"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"p` in one rule. Rules are tried in file order; the first match wins.
- **`peak: false`** — a vendor "},{"id":"p13s4","text":"that does not split peak/off-peak gets one group of three numbers (`cacheHit` 缓存命中, `cacheMiss` 缓存未命"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"中, `output` 输出); the peak window is ignored for it.
- **`peak: true`** — six numbers: `price.peak` +"},{"id":"p13s6","text":" `price.offPeak`, chosen by the message's Beijing hour.
- Units are **CNY per million tokens**. The "},{"id":"p13s7","text":"window logic itself (hours from `peakWindows`, weekends always off-peak) stays in code because it is"},{"id":"p13s8","text":" billing semantics, not price data.
- A model absent from the table is counted as tokens only (`unpr"},{"id":"p13s9","text":"iced`) instead of being priced with a guess; a missing/broken file falls back to a built-in flash ta"},{"id":"p13s10","text":"ble so costs never silently drop to zero."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### 🟢 OpenCode Go 用量 (rolling / weekly / monthly)
- 会话头部新增一个 `Go` 按钮（与余额按钮并列于顶端）：默认只显示**滚动 / 周 / 月**"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"三个用量的百分比
- 点开后用**进度条**展示每个窗口用量，并显示各自的**重置时间**，以及上次刷新时间与实际使用的密钥名
- **刷新时机跟随两条 Go 路由的请求**：`opencodego`"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"（自建供应商）与 `opencode-go`（DSH 官方供应商）任一发出请求（会话事件里的 `assistant/message` 或 `request/header` 带 `provider`），"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"宿主就把用量版本号 +1，前端下次轮询才去上游拉一次；没有请求时前端每 5 秒问的只是本地宿主，宿主直接回缓存（不一定打上游）。点开面板会强刷一次（`?force=1`）
- 快照缓存 5 分钟保质、"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"4 秒内合并连发的刷新；上游临时取不到时继续显示上次结果并给出提醒，不会把面板清空
- 数据来自 OpenCode Go 官方用量接口 `GET https://opencode.ai/zen/go/"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"v1/usage`（Bearer 鉴权），由 host 端代理，key 通过 `ctx.credentials.resolve` 按 `OPENCODEGO_API_KEY` → `OPENCODE_"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"GO_API_KEY` 顺序解析（前者 401/403 时自动退回后者），**从不入源码/浏览器**
- 该接口为社区发现的非官方文档化接口，响应结构可能随 OpenCode 变动；窗口解析做了兼容（"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"`usage.` 前缀或裸窗口、`resetsAt` 或 `resetsInSeconds`）"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"or from GitHub:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Restart DSH afterwards."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Requirements
